# Golden tests (spec 05-quality/testing-strategy.md "DSP goldens from the research models"), label "golden".
#
#   tests/golden/<name>/cases.json      the recipe (hand-written): model adapter, C++ subject, cases
#   tests/golden/<name>/<case>.json     generated by tools/golden-gen/gen.py with <case>.in.f32 / <case>.out.f32
#   tests/golden/harness/               the C++ runner, the subjects, GainTest, the harness self-tests
#
# Every case of every cases.json becomes a ctest (re-configured when a cases.json changes):
#   golden: <name>/<case>                   tolerance comparison (max |err| <= 1e-5 x peak, residual <= -100 dBFS)
#   golden: <name>/<case> [parity]          bit-exact, for cases with "parity": true
#   golden: <name>/<case> [fault: <f>]      for "fault_tests": the subject with a deliberately broken <f> must FAIL
#                                           with a readable report (the test passes when it does)
#   golden: gen --check                     tools/golden-gen/gen.py --all --check (skipped without the research models)
#   golden: gen self-test                   tests/golden/harness/test_golden_gen.py
#   golden: harness.*                       Catch2 self-tests of the comparator, GainTest's EffectBase contract
# Recipes with "local_only": true (models needing firmware-derived inputs) read build/golden-local/
# and are skipped (exit 77) where they have not been generated locally — always in CI.
#
# Adding a golden: write tests/golden/<name>/cases.json, an adapter in tools/golden-gen/goldenlib/models/ and a subject
# in tests/golden/harness/ (Subject.h), run tools/golden-gen/gen.py <name>, commit the case files (CI-generatable only).

set(harness ${APP_TARGET_PREFIX}_golden_harness)
add_library(${harness} STATIC
    harness/GoldenCase.cpp
    harness/Subjects.cpp
    harness/GainTestSubject.cpp
    harness/FxShellSubject.cpp
    harness/TrackStripSubject.cpp
    harness/FiltSubject.cpp
    harness/CompressorSubject.cpp
    harness/DuckerSubject.cpp
    harness/EffectSubject.cpp
    harness/OscillatorSubject.cpp
    harness/ModSubject.cpp
    harness/DelaySubject.cpp
    harness/RoutingSubject.cpp)
target_link_libraries(${harness} PUBLIC app::engine app::core app::juce)
target_include_directories(${harness} PUBLIC ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR} ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src)
app_target_defaults(${harness})
# Bit-exact parity with the float32 models: no fused multiply-add contraction in the harness, GainTest and the strip.
target_compile_options(${harness} PUBLIC -ffp-contract=off)

set(runner ${APP_TARGET_PREFIX}_golden_runner)
add_executable(${runner} harness/runner_main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(${runner} PRIVATE ${harness})
# fx.effect builds effects from the registry: the engine and core registrars (APP_REGISTER_EFFECT / _PARAMS) must link.
app_link_modules(${runner} app::engine app::core)
target_compile_definitions(${runner} PRIVATE APP_SOURCE_DIR="${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}" APP_ARTIFACT_DIR="${APP_ARTIFACT_DIR}")
app_target_defaults(${runner})

file(GLOB APP_GOLDEN_RECIPES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/*/cases.json)
foreach(recipe IN LISTS APP_GOLDEN_RECIPES)
    set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${recipe})
    get_filename_component(dir ${recipe} DIRECTORY)
    get_filename_component(name ${dir} NAME)
    file(READ ${recipe} json)
    string(JSON ncases ERROR_VARIABLE err LENGTH "${json}" cases)
    if(err)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "${recipe}: ${err}")
    endif()
    math(EXPR last "${ncases} - 1")
    # Local-only recipes ("local_only": true) also carry the label golden-private.
    string(JSON local_only ERROR_VARIABLE lerr GET "${json}" local_only)
    set(extra_labels "")
    if(NOT lerr AND local_only)
        set(extra_labels ";golden-private")
    endif()
    foreach(i RANGE ${last})
        string(JSON id GET "${json}" cases ${i} id)
        set(test "golden: ${name}/${id}")
        add_test(NAME "${test}" COMMAND ${runner} ${recipe} ${id})
        set_tests_properties("${test}" PROPERTIES LABELS "golden;${name}${extra_labels}" SKIP_RETURN_CODE 77)
        string(JSON parity ERROR_VARIABLE perr GET "${json}" cases ${i} parity)
        if(NOT perr AND parity)
            add_test(NAME "${test} [parity]" COMMAND ${runner} ${recipe} ${id} --parity)
            set_tests_properties("${test} [parity]" PROPERTIES LABELS "golden;${name};parity${extra_labels}" SKIP_RETURN_CODE 77)
        endif()
        string(JSON nfault ERROR_VARIABLE ferr LENGTH "${json}" cases ${i} fault_tests)
        if(NOT ferr AND nfault GREATER 0)
            math(EXPR flast "${nfault} - 1")
            foreach(j RANGE ${flast})
                string(JSON fault GET "${json}" cases ${i} fault_tests ${j})
                set(ftest "${test} [fault: ${fault}]")
                add_test(NAME "${ftest}" COMMAND ${runner} ${recipe} ${id} --fault ${fault} --expect-failure)
                # Passes only when the broken subject fails with the readable report (frame, block, offset, values).
                set_tests_properties("${ftest}" PROPERTIES LABELS "golden;${name};fault" SKIP_RETURN_CODE 77
                    PASS_REGULAR_EXPRESSION "GOLDEN FAIL ${name}/${id} \\[fault: ${fault}\\].*max \\|err\\| .* at frame [0-9]+ \\(block [0-9]+, offset [0-9]+\\): expected .*, got .*GOLDEN OK ${name}/${id}: expected failure detected")
            endforeach()
        endif()
    endforeach()
endforeach()

# The generator: committed goldens are up to date with the models (needs ../PioneerSP16FirmwareResearch: skip, 77).
add_test(NAME "golden: gen --check" COMMAND Python3::Interpreter -B ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/golden-gen/gen.py --all --check)
set_tests_properties("golden: gen --check" PROPERTIES LABELS "golden" SKIP_RETURN_CODE 77)
add_test(NAME "golden: gen self-test" COMMAND Python3::Interpreter -B ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/harness/test_golden_gen.py)
set_tests_properties("golden: gen self-test" PROPERTIES LABELS "golden" SKIP_RETURN_CODE 77
    ENVIRONMENT "APP_SOURCE_DIR=${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}")

# Harness self-tests (Catch2): comparator, report, GainTest's EffectBase contract, every case loads and its subject exists.
file(GLOB_RECURSE APP_GOLDEN_SELFTEST CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/harness/selftest/*.cpp)
if(APP_GOLDEN_SELFTEST)
    app_add_test_executable(${APP_TARGET_PREFIX}_golden_selftest "golden" "golden: " ${APP_GOLDEN_SELFTEST})
    target_link_libraries(${APP_TARGET_PREFIX}_golden_selftest PRIVATE ${harness})
endif()
